bio: Between the Durance River and the Sud Luberon, this modern restaurant lives up to its name with a lovely shaded terrasse enveloped by the sound of the cicadas (cigales)… plus, you get attentive, smiling service! Mathieu and Sébastien serve an appetising traditional Provence-inspired menu, as well as a daily special that is great value for money. The delicious dishes are carefully crafted with no messing around. The aim is to keep things simple, flavoursome and generous, while using selected regional ingredients: vegetables and olive oil from the village, lamb from the Alpilles, fish from the Bay of Cannes, beef from the Alpes-de-Haute-Provence. In winter, wood-fire cooking. A pleasant restaurant....
